Freedom's Flame is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Contents

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items, including a booster, 3 weapons, 2 armors, 7 cosmetics, and 300 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 60). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.
